idea: The one habit that fixed my mornings
text:
What if I told you one thing changed everything in my mornings [pause] I stopped rushing out the door [look at camera] and started thinking clearer [smile] Here's the thing this one habit is the only one that mattered [pause]

I started setting a two-minute pause every morning [pause] just to breathe and notice one thing around me [look at the clock] I did this four days a week [pause] for exactly six minutes [pause] and it built a quiet foundation [pause]

Now I wake up with more calm than chaos [pause] nothing more needs to be said [pause] just this feeling
title: The one habit that fixed my mornings
